description.en: Stage, mandap and flowers.

subtitle.en: Stage, mandap, entrance and florals — your whole venue, dressed.

about.en: We treat the venue as one picture rather than a set of separate decorations. Our team visits the hall beforehand, measures the stage and entrance, and plans the colours around your outfits and the time of day the function starts. Fresh flowers are sourced the morning of the event so nothing looks tired by evening, and the full setup is finished and cleaned up well before your first guests arrive.

includes.en: Stage backdrop with floral and fabric work
Mandap setup with pillars and canopy
Entrance arch and pathway decoration
Table and seating arrangements for the head table
LED and warm accent lighting across the stage
Full removal and clean-up after the function

conditions.en: Theme colours and flower types can be changed on request

intro.en: We treat the venue as one picture rather than a set of separate decorations.

description.en: The stage backdrop, built with floral and fabric work.
A full stage and mandap build for an evening wedding. Fresh garlands on the pillars, draped fabric behind the couple, and warm lighting angled so the photographs stay soft rather than washed out.
Two decorated seats set out on the lawn, with floral work across the chair backs and fresh flowers either side.

includes.en: Two decorated seats
Floral work on the chair backs
Fresh flowers either side

description.en: The mandap itself, with pillars and a canopy.
A four-pillar mandap with a covered canopy, garlanded down each pillar and finished with seating underneath.

includes.en: Four decorated pillars
Covered canopy
Fresh garlands and floral work
Seating under the mandap

description.en: The arch at the entrance and the pathway that leads your guests in.
The entrance arch and pathway leading guests in. Built the morning of the function with flowers sourced that day, and matched to the colours used on the stage inside.
A balloon arch over the entrance, colours matched to the rest of the hall.
A petal-strewn walkway leading in from the entrance, laid the morning of the function.
Table and seating arrangements, including the head table.
The head table laid with a greenery runner, candles and place settings for the family.

includes.en: Greenery runner down the table
Candles and holders
Place settings and name cards

description.en: Round guest tables laid across the hall, with chair covers and a centrepiece on every table.
LED and warm accent lighting, set across the stage and the hall.
Warm string lights run overhead across the seating area, so the hall keeps its light once the sun goes down.
Warm overhead lighting through the hall, kept low enough that the stage and the tables both read well in photographs.

note.en: Long-lasting silk & plastic blooms — reusable, colour-fast, and doesn't wilt through a long event.

details.en: Made from UV-treated silk and plastic, these blooms hold their colour and shape through a full day outdoors without wilting, drooping or shedding petals. Because they're reusable, they're the most economical way to cover large areas — stage backdrops, pillars, entrance arches — for a flat package price rather than a cost that climbs the more you cover, the way fresh flowers do. Best matched with uplighting or fairy lights to soften the sheen under photos.

extraCharges.en: Setup & removal: ₹500 flat within city limits

range.en: Small — entrance or one photo corner

note.en: Fresh roses, jasmine and marigold sourced the morning of the event for real fragrance and colour.

details.en: Sourced fresh on the morning of the event from local flower markets, so colour and fragrance are at their peak for the ceremony. Best suited to the mandap, bridal bouquet, and any close-up area where guests will actually smell and touch the flowers — fresh stock has a shorter working life than artificial, so it's usually paired with plastic or fabric for the larger background areas.

value.en: Sourced the morning of the event

note.en: Classic orange marigold strings for pillars, entrances and mandap edges.

details.en: Traditional strung marigold garlands in the classic orange-and-yellow combination, sold as a flat-price package sized to cover a doorway, a run of pillars, or the full mandap edge. A staple of South Indian wedding decor that pairs naturally with fresh flowers and fabric drapes, and reads well in both daylight and warm evening light.

note.en: For petal walkways, welcome showers and table scatter.

details.en: Freshly separated rose petals used for the walkway the couple enters on, a welcome shower over the entrance, or scattered across guest tables and the stage. Sold as a flat-price package sized to how thickly you want them scattered, from a short walkway up to a full walkway-plus-shower-plus-table-scatter combination.

note.en: Flowing cloth backdrops in your chosen colour palette.

details.en: Floor-to-ceiling fabric panels draped across the stage or a dedicated photo corner, available in any colour to match your event's palette. Sold as a flat-price package sized to the area you're covering — a full stage backdrop is usually one of the larger line items on a decoration quote — and pairs well with fairy lights woven through the folds.

value.en: Any shade to match your theme

note.en: Warm string lighting woven through florals and drapes for evening glow.

details.en: Warm-white plug-in LED strings, run through floral arrangements, fabric drapes or a canopy overhead to carry the decor from daylight into evening. Sold as a flat-price package sized to the length of run you need — a small add-on to any of the other materials rather than a standalone look, but it's the detail that shows up most in evening photographs.

extraCharges.en: Power point setup: ₹300 flat if none nearby

note.en: Colour-matched balloon arches and clusters for entrances and photo corners.

details.en: Air- or helium-filled balloons arranged into arches over an entrance or clustered as a backdrop for a photo corner, in any colour combination you request. Sold as a flat-price package sized to the cluster or arch you want — a compact photo-corner cluster and a full entrance arch are priced as two very different packages rather than a per-balloon calculation.

note.en: Decorated pillars and the canopy frame the mandap itself is built from.

details.en: The structural frame the whole mandap is built around — pillars plus the overhead canopy, sold as a flat-price package by pillar count and decorated to match whatever material scheme you choose for flowers and drapes elsewhere. This is the one material that's effectively mandatory for a mandap-style ceremony rather than optional decor, since it's the frame everything else is applied to.

note.en: Coloured LED wash lights along the stage backdrop for depth in photos.

details.en: Colour-changeable RGB wash lights aimed up along the stage backdrop, adding depth and a wash of colour behind the couple that a flat backdrop alone doesn't give you in photos. Sold as a flat-price package by light count, spaced evenly across the backdrop width, and colours can usually be matched to your event's theme on request.

note.en: Lightweight carved shapes for stage motifs and entrance signage.

details.en: Thermocol and foam cut and carved into stage motifs, entrance signage lettering, or decorative shapes, then painted or covered to match the event palette. Sold as a flat-price package sized to the carved surface you need — lightweight enough to mount on a backdrop or freestanding frame without extra structural support, and easy to touch up between events.

description.en: Catering with menu planning.

subtitle.en: A full menu planned with you, cooked on site and served hot.

about.en: We sit down with you to build the menu around the tastes of your family and the traditions of the function, rather than handing you a fixed list. Cooking happens at the venue on the day so nothing is reheated, and our serving team is briefed on the running order so food goes out at the right moment. Guest counts can be adjusted up to three days before the event.

includes.en: Menu planning session with tasting for the main dishes
On-site cooking team for the day of the function
Buffet counters with serving staff in uniform
Traditional sweets and dessert counter
Water, welcome drinks and buttermilk service
Crockery, serving vessels and full clean-up

notice.en: Final guest count needed 3 days before

conditions.en: Live counters and speciality dishes available as add-ons

description.en: Full-day photo coverage.

subtitle.en: Two photographers, the full day, from morning rituals to send-off.

about.en: Our approach is to stay out of the way and let the day happen. Two photographers work the function together so that one is always on the couple while the other covers family, guests and the small moments in between. We shoot the traditional posed portraits your family will want framed, but the bulk of the collection is candid work. Every delivered photo is colour corrected by hand.

includes.en: Two photographers for the full day of the function
Morning preparation and getting-ready coverage
Complete ceremony and ritual coverage
Posed family and group portraits
Reception and send-off coverage
400+ hand-corrected photographs delivered online

conditions.en: Pre-wedding and reception-day shoots available on request

description.en: A cinematic wedding film.

subtitle.en: A cinematic record of the day, shot to be watched years later.

about.en: We film the wedding the way a short film is made, with attention to sound, light and pacing, not just a running record of events. The team works with stabilised cameras for movement and places discreet microphones so the vows, speeches and blessings are actually audible. You receive both a short highlight film for sharing and the longer full-ceremony cut for the family.

includes.en: Two camera operators for the full day
Stabilised camera work for movement and detail shots
Clip-on and ambient microphones for vows and speeches
5-8 minute cinematic highlight film
Full-length ceremony recording, lightly edited
Delivered online plus a copy on a USB drive

conditions.en: Drone coverage available as an add-on, subject to venue permission

description.en: A hand-designed album.

subtitle.en: A printed album laid out by hand, page by page, not by template.

about.en: The album is designed around your photographs rather than dropped into a template. We shortlist the strongest images with you, then lay out each spread so the story of the day reads in order from morning to send-off. Printing is done on thick photographic paper with a lay-flat binding, so a portrait across two pages is not cut in half by the spine.

includes.en: Photo shortlisting session with your family
Hand-designed layout for every spread
40-page album on thick lay-flat photographic paper
Hard cover with your names and the wedding date
One round of layout changes before printing
Protective box for storage

notice.en: Turnaround: 3-4 weeks after photos are selected

conditions.en: Smaller duplicate copies for parents available on request

description.en: Cut, graded and scored.

subtitle.en: Your footage cut, graded and scored into a film worth rewatching.

about.en: Bring us footage from any source — our shoot, another videographer, or family phone recordings — and we will build it into a proper film. The work covers cutting for pace, colour grading so shots from different cameras match, cleaning up the audio on vows and speeches, and scoring the piece to music you choose. You see a first cut and can request changes before the final version.

includes.en: Review and sorting of all supplied footage
Colour grading so every camera matches
Audio cleanup on vows, speeches and blessings
Background score from a music track you choose
Opening and closing titles with your names
Two rounds of revisions before the final file

conditions.en: Works with footage from any camera or phone

description.en: Retouching and grading.

subtitle.en: Careful retouching that still looks like you on the day.

about.en: Editing is done photo by photo rather than by applying one filter across the set. We correct exposure and white balance so skin tones look natural under hall lighting, even out colour differences between cameras, and retouch distractions in the frame. Retouching on faces is kept light by default — the aim is a photograph your family recognises, not a repainted one.

includes.en: Exposure and white balance correction on every photo
Colour grading for a consistent look across the set
Natural skin retouching on portraits
Removal of distracting objects in the background
Black and white versions of selected portraits
Full-resolution files delivered online

conditions.en: Heavier retouching and restoration priced separately
